name: "fixture-project"

updated: "2026-01-01"

## Project Identity

Fixture Project is a deterministic sample vault. It exists to prove that the
SessionStart snapshot renders byte-identically when the vault is under budget,
so the demotion ladder can be reworked without silently reshaping the format.

## Warnings & Non-Negotiables

- Never add dated frontmatter to this fixture. A `date:` field on a knowledge
  file makes the render clock-dependent and the golden rots overnight.
- Never add a contextual reminder trigger here. A matching trigger increments
  `fired_count` and rewrites `.sleep.json`, so run two would differ from run one.

## User (Preferences, Project Details, Rules)

## User Preferences

- Prefers a fixture that fails loudly over a golden that quietly drifts.
- **No em dashes** in fixture prose. Commas and periods only.

## Workflow Notes

- Run `npm test` before considering a change complete.
- Regenerate this golden only from the recorded BASE_SHA worktree, never from
  the working tree.

## Task Format Override (ACTIVE — follow for every task)

This project OVERRIDES the default task shape via `_dream_context/overrides/task.md`.
When you CREATE or RECONCILE a task, follow THAT file — its section layout and its
`## Agent Instructions` — not the defaults, and set the custom fields below.

**This project defines custom fields on EVERY task.** They live in the task's `custom_fields:`
frontmatter, sync to ClickUp/GitHub, and are shown when you read or list a task. Set them with
`dreamcontext tasks field <slug> <key> <value>` (or `tasks create --field key=value`):
- **[REQUIRED]** **[ASK THE USER]** **Estimate** (id `estimate`, text) — How long will this take? Ask the user, do not guess.

ASK-FIRST: the field(s) marked **[ASK THE USER]** — `estimate` — capture a HUMAN judgment (e.g. how long the work will take, its business impact). Do NOT make up a value. When you create a task on the user's request, ASK the user for each one BEFORE creating the task — a single concise question per field, using its prompt above as the framing (use the AskUserQuestion tool if you have it, otherwise just ask in chat) — and wait for the answer. Only if there is NO user to ask (an autonomous reconcile or a sleep cycle): leave the field unset and note it, rather than inventing a value.

RULE: the REQUIRED field(s) — `estimate` — must be filled on every task before it leaves `todo`. Never create or complete a task with a required custom field left empty.

Agent Instructions (verbatim from the override):
Every task carries an Estimate. Ask the user for it at creation time.

## Memory (Technical Decisions, Known Issues, Session Log)

---
name: fixture-memory
type: memory
---

## Active Memory

Current focus: proving the snapshot's section joins are byte-stable.

## Technical Decisions

- **The fixture is date-free by construction**: no `date:` on knowledge files,
  no lab cache, no automations, no objectives, no theses. Nothing in the render
  path reaches for the clock, which is what makes a checked-in golden durable.
- **Linked repo is declared but missing locally**: the missing branch renders
  `(missing; ...)` with no absolute path, so the golden is portable across
  machines and CI.
- **`sleep_history` is omitted**: `readSleepState` migrates a non-empty
  `sleep_history` out of `.sleep.json` and rewrites the file, which would mutate
  the fixture on first read.

## Known Issues

- Objectives, theses, automations and warm-knowledge staleness are deliberately
  absent. Each is clock-dependent and is covered by its own suite plus the live
  meta-marketer canary.

## Extended Core Files

- **Tech Stack** (_dream_context/core/3.tech_stack.md): Node 18+, TypeScript ESM, vitest. No runtime deps in the fixture.
- **Style Guide** (_dream_context/core/4.style_guide.md): Plain prose, no em dashes, 4px grid for any UI the fixture pretends to have.

## Bookmarks

- *** The never-evict tier is what busts the harness limit, not the demotable sections. (task: alpha-harness-fit)
- ** Splitting a flush at any element boundary is byte-neutral because join inserts exactly one newline either way.
- * Golden fixtures must be date-free or they rot.

## Recent Changelog

- 2026-01-05 [feat] snapshot: Section flush boundaries became individually addressable
    Each snapshot block now seals into a named budget section instead of one flat parts array, so a section can carry its own demotion ladder without moving any bytes in the full render.
- 2026-01-04 [fix] budget: Demotion rungs resolve lazily
    Rungs are thunks now, so an under-budget vault resolves none of them and pays nothing on the SessionStart hot path.
- 2026-01-03 [test] fixtures: Golden fixture pinned to a recorded base SHA
    The expected render is generated in a detached worktree at the recorded BASE_SHA so it can never be circular with the change under test.
